explanation: On Wikipedia’s account the rally of the 13th and the message to Congress of the 15th marked the end of conciliation: the president had opted for confrontation at the end of February and meant to hold rallies until a general strike on 1 May. The opposition answered in kind — Ademar de Barros demanding impeachment on the 15th, the March of the Family with God for Liberty on the 20th, the sailors’ revolt on the 25th, the Automóvel Clube on the 30th — and the officers moved on the 31st. `precondition-of` rather than `caused`, deliberately: the conspiracy had been running since 1961 and the men who brought the date forward had reasons of their own, from Guedes’s imminent replacement to Mourão’s compulsory retirement. What the rally supplied was the confrontation, not the decision.
